resetLocalDataThisDeviceOnly.dialogBody: This will delete local messages and clear synced remote data for this device only. It will NOT delete your app lock password or your AI/sync settings. You will need to unlock again.
resetLocalDataThisDeviceOnly.cleanupFailedAfterCommit: Data was reset, but some local files could not be cleaned up: $error

resetLocalDataAllDevices.dialogBody: This will delete local messages and clear all synced remote data. It will NOT delete your app lock password or your AI/sync settings. You will need to unlock again.
resetLocalDataAllDevices.cleanupFailedAfterCommit: Data was reset, but some local files could not be cleaned up: $error

debugResetLocalDataAllDevices.subtitle: Delete local messages + clear all remote data
